entities.summary: Rear Admiral Wolfgang Enrique Larrazábal Ugueto  was a Venezuelan naval officer and politician. He served as President of Venezuela following the overthrow of Marcos Pérez Jiménez in the 23 January 1958 Venezuelan coup d'état, stepping down later that year.
